as_told.title: Intelligence calls to Bill Moore after the Roswell book tour

plain: In 1980, while the UFO author Bill Moore was touring with his book The Roswell Incident, about a craft said to have crashed in New Mexico in 1947, the same mysterious voice kept phoning him at radio stations. Those calls led him to meet a man named Rick Doty and an insider known only as "Falcon." The writer Greg Bishop tells it to Michels as Moore told it. He says that when Moore got to Albuquerque, "the next stop on his book tour," he walked into the radio station and "same thing happens, same voice." The researcher Grant Cameron tells it too, summarising it without a source. His version is a little different: the first call came "seven days after" the tour began, and it was "probably from" Doty in Albuquerque. The calls are tied to a meeting about security at Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, which is told as a separate story. If the story is true, people on the inside went looking for a UFO author in order to reach him and steer him.
